title: Megurine Luka — Making Lanterns Looks Fun!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see... We have our milk cartons, scissors, tape and stickers...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, I think we're all set!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len and the others should be able to make their lanterns however they like now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting them to say that they'd also like to make their own lanterns...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe... My lantern must've made them feel that way because of how beautifully it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Luka!
We heard that you were ready for us...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, everything's all set!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Look at all the milk cartons and stickers...!
Where did you get these?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Kohane and the others actually lent me a hand with these!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When I told them about how you all wanted to make lanterns, they decided to help me gather everything.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, we'll need to thank them the next chance we get.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And thanks for doing all this for us, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Anyway, let's get started, shall we?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I have pictures of the ones Kohane and the others made. We might be able to use them as reference, so let me go get them now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, nice one!
Then, once she's come back with those, let's start making our lanterns!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are these the pictures of the one Akito made? It's so cool how light pokes out of all these different holes!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think I'll try copying him...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This might put your designing skills to the test since these holes are all different in terms of shape and size.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My designing skills... Alright, I've got this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm gonna put a bunch of stickers on mine!
We've got a ton, so we might as well use them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, we made sure to get some that we thought you'd like. Let's see... They should be around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We start by peeling off the outer labels, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you need to make a small cut here, and peel very slowly to ensure that it doesn't tear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, phew... I think I'm done.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, you've finished peeling it off already? That took you no time at all...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's how you're supposed to do it...
So, if I do what MEIKO just did and peel like this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, Miku, I think you're going a bit too fast.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It ripped...
But I can still use this as is, can't I?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then, I'll just do that.
I think leaving the label will make it feel more unique.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You might be able to get it all off by going from the other side... But if you're happy with that, Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Humhumhumm♪
I think I'll cut out a star here next.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, KAITO, how many holes are you gonna cut?! Your carton's looking like Swiss cheese!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And yet, he's managed to achieve this kind of beautiful balance. It really is remarkable how good you are at these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, MEIKO... Wait, huh?
Yours seems kinda small...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I decided to make mine a cube, so I cut my carton in half.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It may not be very big...
But it looks cute, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it does!
I think I'll also try making a mini lantern next!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Finished!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cool!
It's really a lantern now...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah, and this light is really soothing for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, let's use these to decorate the cafe!
I really want Kohane and the others to see them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay.
Why don't we hang them up by the entrance?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I can't wait to see how they react!
